hooks.command:
input=$(cat)
f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | python -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print((d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))
")
case "$f" in
  *.kt)
    out=$(./gradlew ktlintCheck 2>&1); code=$?
    if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then status=falhou; else status=ok; fi
    printf '%s' "$out" | python -c "
import json,sys
f=sys.argv[1]; status=sys.argv[2]; out=sys.stdin.read()
if status=='falhou':
    msg='ktlintCheck falhou depois de editar '+f+'. Rode ./gradlew ktlintFormat para corrigir automaticamente.\n'+out[-1500:]
else:
    msg='ktlintCheck ok depois de editar '+f+'.'
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PostToolUse','additionalContext':msg}}))
" "$f" "$status"
    ;;
esac

touched=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- . | cut -c4- | grep -E '\.(kt|kts)$' | grep -E '(^|/)src/')
if [ -n "$touched" ]; then
  out=$(./gradlew test lint ktlintCheck 2>&1); code=$?
  printf '%s' "$out" | python -c "
import json,sys
code=int(sys.argv[1]); out=sys.stdin.read()
if code!=0:
    msg='Gate do CLAUDE.md falhou: ./gradlew test lint ktlintCheck nao passou (ha .kt/.kts com mudanca pendente em src/). Corrija antes de considerar a tarefa pronta.\n'+out[-3000:]
    print(json.dumps({'decision':'block','reason':msg}))
else:
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'gradlew test lint ktlintCheck passou - gate do CLAUDE.md OK.'}))
" "$code"
fi
